label: learning_insights_empty
title: Insights
body: Local trace analysis has no readable week. Saved imports and daemon counter feed are separate.

label: learning_insights_busy
title: Insights
body: Copy, saved snapshots and week reads can finish independently.

label: learning_insights
title: Insights
body: The chosen feed owns all figures for the week.

label: learning_insights_error
title: Insights
body: A failed read clears the affected figures; saved-feed fallback can remain available.

label: learning_missions_empty
title: Mission drafts
body: No mission drafts have been read.

label: learning_missions
title: Mission drafts
body: Local imported drafts are separate from server mission publication.

label: learning_mission_busy
title: Mission drafts
body: An import or deletion is still executing; closing cannot cancel the native mutation.

label: learning_skill_empty
title: Learn from trace
body: Resolve local install status before starting a new candidate.

label: learning_skill_busy
title: Learning…
body: The selected workflow has an operation in flight.

label: learning_skill_candidate
title: Candidate skill
body: Edit a candidate, then review its exact package.

label: learning_skill_review
title: Exact installable package
body: Approve the disclosed evaluation requests for the reviewed package.

label: learning_skill_results
title: Held-out plan results
body: Passing evaluation allows reviewing installation; it does not itself install or publish.

label: learning_skill_plan
title: Installation preview
body: The plan names package and ownership-marker digests.

label: learning_skill_installed
title: Installed in Codex
body: Actual filesystem installation and UI reconciliation remain distinct.

label: learning_rollback_confirm
title: Roll back this skill?
body: Rollback verifies the installed package and marker are unchanged.

label: learning_skill_error
title: Learn from trace
body: The failed operation retains phase-specific recovery state.

label: learning_publication
title: Public run
body: Publication is a separately approved account operation.

label: learning_closed
title: No learning window open
body: A detached local mutation or filesystem install can finish after closure.
